title: The Hands
tagline: My phone, a real browser, an image maker and the graphics card.
what: These are the things the AI can reach beyond the chat: my phone's screen, a web browser I signed into by hand, an image maker, and a queue for my graphics card. They let a job keep going instead of stopping to hand me a chore.
built: It can see and tap my phone's screen to clear a sign-in prompt. Banking apps show it black, so those come to me.
A real Chrome I signed into by hand, because login pages turn away a scripted browser
An image maker that runs through my own ChatGPT, for quick mockups and sketches while I plan.
A queue so AI jobs on my PC take turns on its one graphics card, and give it up when I stream a game
credit: Built it on top of Claude Code
starring: The AI, doing the parts I used to do by hand

making.problem: Jobs kept stopping on things only I could reach: a tap on my phone, a login page that blocked robots, a graphics card two programs wanted at once.

steps.name: Reach
steps.says: The AI asks for a tool: the phone, the browser, the image maker or the graphics card.

steps.name: Do it
steps.says: It taps, clicks or draws the way I would, in my own signed-in apps.

steps.name: Hand back
steps.says: If a screen is blocked to it or wants my face or fingerprint, it stops and asks me.

moment.what: The AI works in a real browser I signed into by hand, in my own apps. It can carry on through the login page and do the clicks I'd otherwise have to take over.
